Variant of: Militech Mk. 31 HMG
Cost: 2,500eb (Luxury)
Class: Exotic Poor Quality Machine Gun
Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 5), Suppressive Fire

Ironfake variant: an Exotic, Poor Quality bootleg of the listed original. Every BODY requirement of the original goes up by 1. Can't be bought through the Edgerunners Mission Kit option of paying double to skip the Fixer. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

Autofire (Machine Gun 5) and Suppressive Fire only, each using 20 rounds. Needs BODY 12+ to wield unless mounted; without BODY 14+ the wielder takes -2 MOVE. Reloading takes 3 Actions.

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
